none: PAS NLM-7ACA11: Roman Coin: probable Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin fragment. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), probably a Soli Invicto Comiti issue of 310-319, Reece period 15. Obverse description: Bust possibly cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [--]CON[--]. Reverse description: Probably Sol standing left with cloak, arm raised. Reverse inscription: Probably [SOLI INVICTO COMITI]. Diameter: 19.2mm, Weight: 1.88gms, die axis: probably 12
